title: Built by Strengthening, and Where the Idea Stops

scenes.tts: The adult wiring is lopsided. Was it built by cutting connections, or by strengthening them?
scenes.visual: Title card: Built by Strengthening, and Where the Idea Stops. A gold ganglion cell between two starburst cells, one thick connection and one thin. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: The adult wiring is lopsided. Was it built by cutting connections, or by strengthening them?

scenes.tts: Pruning would start symmetric and delete the preferred-side connections. Strengthening would keep both sides and grow the null side.
scenes.visual: Two hypothesis panels: scissors cutting the preferred-side link; a null-side link thickening while the other stays.
scenes.narration: Pruning would start symmetric and delete the preferred-side connections. Strengthening would keep both sides and grow the null side.

scenes.tts: Remember, the null side is the side a null-direction stimulus comes from.
scenes.visual: Arrow showing null motion arriving from the null side. Label: null side.
scenes.narration: Remember, the null side is the side a null-direction stimulus comes from.

scenes.tts: Wei, Hamby, Zhou and Feller recorded pairs in mouse retina. Each pair was one starburst cell and one ganglion cell.
scenes.visual: Label: Wei, Hamby, Zhou and Feller, 2011, paired recordings, mouse retina, ganglion cells of one labelled type that all prefer the same direction. Two pipettes on a starburst cell and a ganglion cell.
scenes.narration: Wei, Hamby, Zhou and Feller recorded pairs in mouse retina. Each pair was one starburst cell and one ganglion cell.

scenes.tts: They stimulated one starburst cell at a time, and measured the inhibition the ganglion cell received.
scenes.visual: One starburst cell flashes; an inhibitory current trace appears in the ganglion cell.
scenes.narration: They stimulated one starburst cell at a time, and measured the inhibition the ganglion cell received.

scenes.tts: At postnatal days four and seven, inhibition was similar from the two sides.
scenes.caption: At postnatal days 4 and 7, inhibition was similar from the two sides.
scenes.visual: Panel labelled P4 and P7: equal connections from the null and preferred sides.
scenes.narration: At postnatal days 4 and 7, inhibition was similar from the two sides.

scenes.tts: Predict. What should later recordings show under pruning? And what under strengthening?
scenes.visual: An empty later panel beside the P4 and P7 panel. On screen: delete the preferred side, or strengthen the null side?
scenes.narration: Predict. What should later recordings show under pruning? And what under strengthening?

scenes.tts: Null-side inhibition grew. Preferred-side inhibition stayed about the same, and was still there in adult retina.
scenes.visual: The later panel fills: the null-side link thickens, the preferred-side link stays the same; a crossed-out scissors icon over the preferred-side link rejects wholesale loss of preferred-side connections (individual synapse turnover was not measured).
scenes.narration: Null-side inhibition grew. Preferred-side inhibition stayed about the same, and was still there in adult retina.

scenes.tts: So development strengthened one side. It did not delete the other.
scenes.narration: So development strengthened one side. It did not delete the other.

scenes.tts: Later paired recordings from the same laboratory asked why. The authors concluded that null-side pairs had more synapses, not stronger ones.
scenes.caption: Later paired recordings from the same laboratory asked why. Null-side pairs had more synapses, not stronger ones.
scenes.visual: Label: Morrie and Feller, 2015. The null-side link splits into more synapse dots of the same size.
scenes.narration: Later paired recordings from the same laboratory asked why. Null-side pairs had more synapses, not stronger ones.

scenes.tts: One more test. Delete the starburst cells' vesicular gabba transporter. Their gabba release drops, but their acetylcholine stays.
scenes.caption: One more test. Delete the starburst cells' vesicular GABA transporter. Their GABA release drops, but their acetylcholine stays.
scenes.visual: Label: Pei and colleagues, 2015, mouse. Starburst cells with fewer GABA vesicles (reduced, not gone); acetylcholine vesicles intact.
scenes.narration: One more test. Delete the starburst cells' vesicular GABA transporter. Their GABA release drops, but their acetylcholine stays.

scenes.tts: Predict. If the veto were the whole mechanism, what would happen to direction selectivity?
scenes.visual: Two rasters, preferred and null, waiting to be drawn. On screen: does direction selectivity vanish?
scenes.narration: Predict. If the veto were the whole mechanism, what would happen to direction selectivity?

scenes.tts: Inhibition lost its direction tuning. But direction selectivity survived in a subset of on-off cells.
scenes.caption: Inhibition lost its direction tuning. But direction selectivity survived in a subset of ON-OFF cells.
scenes.visual: Inhibition bars for the two directions become equal. Some ON-OFF ganglion cells keep a weaker lopsided raster; others lose it.
scenes.narration: Inhibition lost its direction tuning. But direction selectivity survived in a subset of ON-OFF cells.

scenes.tts: There, tuned excitation and the timing of residual inhibition supported selectivity. Direction tuning of inhibition is important, but some cells can remain selective without it.
scenes.caption: There, tuned excitation and the timing of residual inhibition supported selectivity. Direction tuning of inhibition is important, but some cells can remain selective without it.
scenes.visual: Label on the surviving cells: tuned excitation; timing of residual, untuned inhibition relative to excitation. Caption: tuned inhibition is important; some cells stay selective without it.
scenes.narration: There, tuned excitation and the timing of residual inhibition supported selectivity. Direction tuning of inhibition is important, but some cells can remain selective without it.

scenes.tts: Keep the sign. The strongest inhibition prefers roughly the direction the ganglion cell ignores.
scenes.visual: The circuit picture returns: mostly left-pointing spokes connected to the rightward-preferring cell, with a short on-screen reminder of the sign.
scenes.narration: Keep the sign. The strongest inhibition prefers roughly the direction the ganglion cell ignores.

scenes.tts: It is best established in adult mouse and rabbit. The primate circuit is less studied, and the fly uses different cells.
scenes.visual: Scope labels: adult mouse and rabbit; primate, less studied; fly, similar computation with different cells.
scenes.narration: It is best established in adult mouse and rabbit. The primate circuit is less studied, and the fly uses different cells.
